La vie des autres, le doute en soi: Other people’s lives, our own self-doubt
Le fil défile. Une promotion, une villa,: The feed keeps scrolling. A promotion, a villa, a flawless body, another trip. Nothing reveals what was edited out: the waiting, the debts, the ordinary days. Yet we compare this selection with our entire lives. We set their chosen moments against our difficult mornings.
Le piège se referme quand l’image cesse: The trap closes when the image stops being entertainment and becomes a demand. We should succeed faster, look happier, own more. A quiet day starts to feel like a wasted one. Eventually, we find ourselves asking strangers for permission to be content with our own lives.
Acheter sa place dans le regard des autr: Buying a place in other people’s eyes
Un produit apparaît sur l’écran, porté p: A product appears on screen, worn by someone whose routines, confidences and travels we follow. The offer arrives in what feels like a familiar conversation. We are no longer being promised just an object: we are being offered a place in a desirable world.
Le danger commence lorsque l’achat devie: The danger begins when a purchase becomes proof of personal worth. The phone still works, but it no longer tells the right story. The clothes still fit, but they no longer signal that we belong. As we keep replacing things to stay visible, we can lose sight of a simple question: did we actually want them?
Une personne trébuche, se trompe ou craq: Someone stumbles, makes a mistake or breaks down. Someone else films it. Within seconds, a vulnerable moment becomes a clip to comment on. Behind a screen, it is easy to forget that life continues after the video, far from the laughter and the view count.
Chaque partage nous place devant un choi: Every share presents a choice: extend the spectacle, or refuse to reward it. A society is shaped not only by what it condemns in its words, but also by what it encourages with its attention. When humiliation becomes profitable, protecting another person’s dignity can begin with a small decision: not to click.
